correctness.rationale: Unique degree-two right vertex classifies every tree, giving a verified exact product formula for each Walsh coefficient. The zero/one/no-opposed-pair stratification and binomial identity reconstruct every multiplicity and norm, including n=2, even central zeros, and limiting parity. Exact exhaustive FWHT with independently generated tree masks for n=2,...,8 reproduces complete histograms, Parseval and norm; the universal assertion is derived symbolically.

value.rationale: K2n spanning-tree indicators are canonical graphic-matroid basis signals, and the exact all-n Walsh distribution provides the natural and previously uncomputed sharp endpoint projection norm, exact XOR rank, and an exponential-sparsity/linear-amplification dichotomy. The sqrt(n) correction and exact parity increments distinguish the global signed structure from the elementary spanning-tree count. This is an all-parameter spectral invariant with concrete operator-theoretic and communication-matrix relevance rather than a small or arbitrary enumeration.
